_about: About you (DESIGN.md §2.2 step 2, D21). Owner: App shell agent.

about.age.attest.comment: Checkbox shown only when the birth year is exactly at the minimum age. %lld = app_config.min_user_age. Exact text: docs/legal/consent-texts.*.md §3.
about.age.attest.en: I confirm that I am at least %lld years old.
about.age.attest.vi: Tôi xác nhận tôi đã đủ %lld tuổi.

about.age.blocked.comment: Polite block below the minimum age. %lld = app_config.min_user_age. Exact text: docs/legal/consent-texts.*.md §3.
about.age.blocked.en: Sorry, RacketCoach is currently only for people aged %lld and over.
about.age.blocked.vi: Rất tiếc, RacketCoach hiện chỉ dành cho người từ %lld tuổi trở lên.

about.birth_year.placeholder.comment: First (neutral) row of the birth-year wheel; nothing is pre-selected.

about.birth_year.why.comment: Explains why the birth year is asked.
about.birth_year.why.en: We only use your birth year to check the minimum age.
about.birth_year.why.vi: Chúng tôi chỉ dùng năm sinh để kiểm tra độ tuổi tối thiểu.

about.continue.comment: Button at the bottom of About you; enabled when the age check passes and handedness is chosen.

about.handedness.hint.comment: Hint under the handedness choice (racket for badminton, paddle for pickleball).
about.handedness.hint.en: The hand that holds the racket or paddle.

about.handedness.title.en: Which hand do you play with?

about.level.hint.comment: Hint under the optional level choice. Do not mention club ratings or DUPR.
about.level.hint.en: This helps the AI pitch its feedback at the right level. You can change it later in Settings.
about.level.hint.vi: Giúp AI nhận xét phù hợp với trình độ của bạn. Bạn có thể đổi sau trong Cài đặt.

about.subtitle.en: Three quick questions so the feedback fits you.
about.subtitle.vi: Ba câu hỏi nhanh để nhận xét phù hợp với bạn.

about.title.comment: Title of the About you screen (DESIGN.md §2.2 step 2).
